patent.title: 用于数据处理系统的快闪电子式外存储方法及其装置
assignees: 深圳市朗科科技股份有限公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E4-N3. Grant inventors 邓国顺/成晓华; litigant/owner 朗科. Single-patent Shenzhen intermediate judgment (2014)深中法知民初字第510号. Soft license revenue is patent-pool → NOT encoded as single-patent E4. Invention expired 2019-11-14.

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout; inventor-founded Netac commercialization; inventorship genealogy not fully reconstructed beyond grant inventors and 朗科 plaintiff standing.

technology.problem: 数据处理系统外存储体积大、需关机换盘、缺即插即用 USB 快闪方案。
technology.mechanism: 外存储装置内装快闪介质 + 控制存取与接口标准的固化软件 + 按单一分块组织数据 + 经 USB 建信息通道并由 USB 引入电源（裁判认定 claim 1 要素）。

value_carriers.name: 晶天电子被控 USB 快闪外存储产品（裁判认定侵权）
value_carriers.description: Court found accused Jing Tian USB flash external-storage products practice claim 1 of ZL99117225.6. Carrier is adjudicated infringer product-line, not 朗科 own SKU revenue.

value_metrics.metric_name: court-awarded patent infringement damages and costs (judgment item 二)
value_metrics.note: Dispute-specific E4. Excludes separate storage-fee item 三. Soft 朗科 pool license revenue NOT treated as single-patent E4.

gaps.description: Relative to T0=2026-10-13 the invention term expired 2019-11-14; E4 is historical damages realization, not a live royalty stream. Soft 朗科「专利授权许可收入」is pool/business-line and is demoted (not single-patent E4).
needed_evidence: Live named-ZL royalty schedule post-expiry (none expected)

gaps.description: No field-normalized technical-quality benchmark beyond claim-1 infringement finding.

notes: Holdout E4-N3. T0=2026-10-13. Single-ZL court E3+E4+E5 → R5. Claims-check PASS (court claim 1). Soft license=pool demoted. Expired vs T0 → historical damages gaps. Judgment≠auto R5 without E3/exact_patent—those are present. Not V0.8; not intrinsic price.
